reviewed_by: Claude: Butler mode reply target fix
reason: Butler mode left the composer on 'New thread' after a question started a thread (and when a thread opened from the URL), so the operator's follow-up started another thread. The fix switches the composer to Reply once that thread's answer settles and when ?thread= changes outside openThread. Selected: the Butler mode page unit tests (send + board) and the butler-mode real-Core LAN journey on desktop and compact, which now sends a follow-up in a reloaded thread and checks no new thread is created.
exclusions: UI-only change to ButlerModePage composer state; no Core, Python, or native code changed, so those layers select nothing. Other Butler areas (panel, subagents, board-only journeys) do not use the Butler mode composer target.
